# Restate

Restate is a Software Development company. Restate is a low-latency application runtime that provides flexible building blocks for agents, workflows, and microservices. It offers low latency durable execution driven by a fast distributed log. Restate employs 28 people (+64.7% YoY, +11 people). Headquartered in Berlin, Berlin, Germany. Its workforce is distributed across 8 countries (including United States, Germany, United Kingdom, Belgium, and Cyprus).

## About

Restate is a lightweight runtime to turn AI agents, workflows, and backend services into durable processes. Focus on your logic, not failure mechanics.

- [2026-09-18 · Posted · 22 reactions] [Did you see the new concept of Projects in Claude? Want to build...](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/restatedev_did-you-see-the-new-concept-of-projects-in-activity-7506704611651686401-H1be)
  > Did you see the new concept of Projects in Claude? Want to build something like it for your own agent?
  >
  > A Project is an ongoing conversation that brings related work together. Describe your goal, and Claude splits it into threads, runs them in parallel in the cloud, keeps working after you close your laptop, and lets you steer execution along the way.
  >
  > Building this for production often means stitching together queues, databases, schedulers, and coordination logic.
  >
  > Restate gives you the building blocks for durable asynchronous agents, with recovery, consistency, and coordination built in:
  >
  > → Coordinator + parallel workers
  > Run each agent as a durable function. Call models and sandbox commands as durable steps; delegate to other agents via durable RPC.
  >
  > → Shared memory & library
  > Give each project a Virtual Object with a stable ID, durable state, and callable handlers. Store memory, preferences, and artifact references. Restate serializes updates, so you don’t manage locks.
  >
  > → Unified overview
  > Build your dashboard over durable project and agent state: progress, pending approvals, and results.
  >
  > → Steer on the go
  > Use durable signals to steer execution, interrupt runs, and resolve approvals. Cancellation propagates through nested subagent calls, so you can stop the entire call tree.
  >
  > → Background execution & routines
  > Restate preserves recorded progress through crashes and retries. And lets you schedule recurring routines via durable timers.
  >
  > Self-host Restate for free, or use Restate Cloud/BYOC + serverless functions for a managed production setup without operating infrastructure.
  >
  > These same primitives work for coding agents, research agents, or whatever you’re building next.
